edits.new:
Then nothing changes and the user sees MSG-P7-003

  Scenario: AC4 Field refused (X4)
    Given a record of the plan installment has a missing or invalid field
    When the record is written
    Then nothing is written, the field is named with MSG-P7-009 and the stage stays where it was

  Scenario: AC5 Required value missing (X5)
    Given a required value on the treatment, for example the installment count, is missing
    When the calculation runs
    Then the step holds, names the field, raises a task for the owner, writes no element and shows MSG-GEN-001

  Scenario: AC6 Access refused (X6)
    Given a role without the right
    When it tries to re-run the step or read its result
    Then the access guard returns 403 with MSG-P4-002 and nothing changes

  Scenario: AC7 Stale payoff (X7)
    Given the payoff on the case is older than the freshness limit
    When the step runs
    Then the step warns with MSG-S2-002, requests a fresh figure and does not compute on the stale one

  Scenario: AC8 Duplicate case signal (X8)
    Given a second case signal arrives while the branch is running
    When the inbox receives it
    Then the inbox dedupes it by the cloud event id of the case signal and no second element is written

  Scenario: AC9 Case status not owned (BR8)
    Given the stage has reported its outcome to the parent
    When the parent applies the rule for the status
    Then this service writes no case row and publishes no case event for it
